style: Short, quiet game over music for a lonely retro pixel-art space game: the line goes quiet. A lonely felt piano plays a slow, sad minor phrase over a cold analog synth pad and a sub-bass drone, a faint slow pulse like a blinking lamp, a distant glass bell, tape echo and vast reverb; it fades and ends open and unresolved. Sparse, still, desolate. No drums. Purely instrumental. Dm, 70 BPM.
